name: Hookway
description: Hookway is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted gateway for verifying and routing webhooks, handling HTTP requests, and exposing selected APIs as authenticated MCP tools.

pages.title: Hookway | Self-hosted webhook gateway
pages.description: Verify and route webhooks to queues, streams, databases and APIs. Run Hookway in your infrastructure, with YAML flows, a visual builder and optional MCP tools.

pages.title: Webhook and MCP use cases | Hookway
pages.description: Explore runnable Hookway workflows for webhook routing, queues, multipart files, XML, synchronous HTTP requests and authenticated MCP tools.

pages.title: Self-hosted API-to-MCP gateway | Hookway
pages.description: Expose selected API operations as MCP tools with explicit caller permissions, API keys or OAuth, separate upstream credentials and reviewable YAML.

pages.title: Compare Hookway, Hookdeck and Convoy | Hookway
pages.description: Compare deployment, webhook verification, delivery destinations, recovery and MCP workflows in Hookway, Hookdeck Event Gateway and Convoy, with sources.

pages.title: About the open-source Hookway project
pages.description: Hookway is an MIT-licensed project maintained by Jason Giroux. Learn about self-hosting, the public builder, project boundaries and operational evidence.

pages.title: Website privacy and analytics choices | Hookway
pages.description: Learn how optional Hookway website analytics work, what metadata is collected after permission, and how to change your choice. Self-hosted instances are separate.
